generation_prompt:
Generate market report content for {market_name_title}.

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no explanation, no code blocks):
{{
  "executive_summary_intro": "2-3 sentence intro (~1200 chars) defining {market_name_title} as a low-carbon renewable product, its two forms (bio-methanol and e-methanol), and key applications.",
  "market_definition": "2-3 paragraph definition (~720 chars) covering market overview, key trends, and scope of study.",
  "driver_1": {{"title": "Short title for first driver (~50 chars)", "para1": "First paragraph (~430 chars) about driver 1 context and rationale", "para2": "Second paragraph (~580 chars) with examples and supporting data"}},
  "driver_2": {{"title": "Short title for second driver (~60 chars)", "para1": "First paragraph (~480 chars)", "para2": "Second paragraph (~620 chars)"}},
  "restraint_1": {{"title": "Short title for first restraint (~50 chars)", "para1": "First paragraph (~490 chars)", "para2": "Second paragraph (~550 chars)"}},
  "applications": [
    {{"name": "Application 1 (~25 chars)", "description": "1-sentence description (~100 chars)"}},
    {{"name": "Application 2 (~25 chars)", "description": "1-sentence description (~100 chars)"}},
    {{"name": "Application 3 (~25 chars)", "description": "1-sentence description (~100 chars)"}}
  ]
}}

Rules:
- Use analyst/consulting tone
- No fake statistics or specific numbers
- Stay within character limits
- No markdown formatting, no code blocks, no explanation
- Return ONLY the JSON object
